author: Huawei
description:
Digital transformation is not a one-time project. It is a continuous journey of modernization, adaptation, and trust.
 
As AI reshapes industries, businesses need infrastructure that can keep pace with new demands, such as AI, while keeping data secure.
 
In this #TransformTalks interview, Christophe Hermant, Head of Cloud Infrastructure, Global Delivery and Operations at @orangebusiness, shares why the next phase of transformation is already underway, and why data protection remains critical to business resilience.
 
Discover more insights at https://bit.ly/4uThsaU #Huawei #ThisIsHuawei #HWIDI #HuaweiStorage #DataAwakening #InfraEvolving #Innovation
title: Why Digital Transformation Never Ends
